meta.title: StardewPilot: a copilot for your Stardew Valley farm
meta.description: An AI copilot mod for Stardew Valley. Ask it anything, hand it the chores, or teach it your routine by doing it once.

lead.text: An AI copilot mod for Stardew Valley. Ask it anything, hand it the chores, or teach it your routine by doing it once.

notes.title: Ask anything
notes.text: Crops, gifts, fish, recipes, bundles, where your things are. Answered from your own save, in a private chat on F8.

notes.title: Hand them over
notes.text: Watering, harvest, planting, shopping, shipping, fishing, the mines, animals and machines. It walks and works like a player.
notes.say: water the crops, then go fishing

notes.title: Let it play
notes.text: Set a goal and press F10. Each morning it writes a plan, plays the day, writes a summary and goes to bed.
notes.say: play by yourself, goal: 5,000g by summer

notes.title: It learns you
notes.text: It keeps a diary of what you do by hand, and works out your usual morning, your bedtime and your rainy days.

notes.title: Show it once
notes.text: Say "watch me", do a task by hand, and name it. Run it later, or let it start by itself every morning.

notes.title: It asks first
notes.text: Shipping, selling, gifts and big purchases ask you in the game. Move, and it stops at once.
notes.say: Yes · Yes, and don't ask again · No

calendar.title: Spring, Year 1
legend: Truffle run: starts by itself every morning
Town run: offered at 4pm on Fridays, F7 starts it
A birthday: the morning briefing reminds you
rules: Shipping, selling, gifts and purchases over 500g ask you first
Move or use a tool, and it stops at once. F9 switches it off
At 11:30pm work stops and the farmer goes to bed
Its memory and your diary are plain files on your computer. Game state goes only to the model you choose

start.title: Get started

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Stardew Valley 1.6 on PC with SMAPI 4.5+, Node.js 22.19+ and pi. Unzip the release into your Mods folder.

steps.title: Switch it on
steps.text: In the mod's config.json, set Launcher.Enabled to true, then start the game. The copilot starts with it.

steps.title: Pick a model
steps.text: Press F8 and type /settings. Sign in with a subscription, or add an API key or a model on your own computer.

steps.title: Say hello
steps.text: "What should I do today?" The copilot answers in the language you write in.
